entries.title: Psalms 85:1
segments: ¶<<To the chief Musician, A Psalm for the sons of Korah.>> LORD, thou hast been favourable unto thy land: thou hast brought back the captivity of Jacob. {for the sons: or, of the sons} {favourable: or, well pleased}

words.text: . {for the sons: or, of the sons} {favourable: or, well pleased}

entries.title: Psalms 85:2
segments: Thou hast forgiven the iniquity of thy people, thou hast covered all their sin. Selah.

entries.title: Psalms 85:3
segments: Thou hast taken away all thy wrath: thou hast turned [thyself] from the fierceness of thine anger. {thyself...: or, thine anger from waxing hot}

words.text: . {thyself...: or, thine anger from waxing hot}

entries.title: Psalms 85:4
segments: Turn us, O God of our salvation, and cause thine anger toward us to cease.

entries.title: Psalms 85:5
segments: Wilt thou be angry with us for ever? wilt thou draw out thine anger to all generations?

entries.title: Psalms 85:6
segments: Wilt thou not revive us again: that thy people may rejoice in thee?

entries.title: Psalms 85:7
segments: Shew us thy mercy, O LORD, and grant us thy salvation.

entries.title: Psalms 85:8
segments: ¶I will hear what God the LORD will speak: for he will speak peace unto his people, and to his saints: but let them not turn again to folly.

words.text: : but let them not turn again

entries.title: Psalms 85:9
segments: Surely his salvation [is] nigh them that fear him; that glory may dwell in our land.

entries.title: Psalms 85:10
segments: Mercy and truth are met together; righteousness and peace have kissed [each other].

entries.title: Psalms 85:11
segments: Truth shall spring out of the earth; and righteousness shall look down from heaven.

entries.title: Psalms 85:12
segments: Yea, the LORD shall give [that which is] good; and our land shall yield her increase.

entries.title: Psalms 85:13
segments: Righteousness shall go before him; and shall set [us] in the way of his steps.
